products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-E is a cost-beneficial environmental chamber for laboratories that need stable, repeatable climate control for a defined range of test conditions without unnecessary complexity, available in 201 L and 398 L chamber volumes.
features: Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs, making everyday testing easier to monitor.

Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility, even for repeated test use, while air is circulated at an optimum speed for uniform conditions.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions and reducing losses during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT), providing safer and more accurate over-temperature shutdown even during electronic faults.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, plus low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off, helps prevent dry operation and keeps extended runs safe and uninterrupted.
Efficient Water Recirculation: An efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even for long-term high-humidity tests, with an optional direct water supply system available.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples without disturbing chamber conditions.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC via RS-485 for centralised control, and remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).
Energy-Saving Operation: An energy-saving system performs temperature and humidity tests efficiently, reducing power consumption during operation.
applications: Pharmaceutical Laboratories: Used for stability studies, shelf-life evaluation, packaging testing and general storage-condition simulation within defined temperature and humidity ranges.
Chemical and Material Laboratories: Supports material ageing, environmental exposure testing and reproducibility studies under controlled climate conditions.
Electronics and Component Testing: Suitable for evaluating the behaviour of components and assemblies under controlled temperature and humidity conditions.
Food and Beverage Testing: Used for shelf-life assessment, storage simulation and quality-control testing of food and beverage samples.
Academic and Research Laboratories: Suitable for teaching and research labs that need reliable, repeatable environmental testing with straightforward operation.
Quality Control Laboratories: Supports routine QC workflows where consistent, documented temperature and humidity conditions are required.

longForm.heroLead: Reliable temperature and humidity testing for routine stability, quality control and research workflows.
heroParagraphs: Reliable temperature and humidity testing for routine stability, quality control and research workflows.

The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a cost-beneficial environmental chamber designed for laboratories that need stable, repeatable climate control for a defined range of test conditions without unnecessary complexity.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, excellent thermal insulation and a double-sealed door, the TH3-E delivers dependable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated and long-duration testing.
It is available in 200 L and 400 L chamber volumes, making it suitable for stability studies, material testing, shelf-life evaluation and general environmental testing.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: The TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber supports stability testing, quality control, material evaluation and routine environmental testing workflows.
sections.subheading: Built around the essentials, not unnecessary complexity
body: The TH3-E from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a basic-type environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable climate control across a defined set of temperature and humidity conditions.

Its operating concept is focused on the essentials. A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, and the operating process can be reviewed as a graph for easier monitoring.

A simplified direct water line and electric circuit reduce the chance of faults, while a water level check function prompts refilling at the right time, supporting stable operation during longer tests.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service to help users get the most from their environmental testing workflows.

sections.description: The TH3-E offers programmable multi-segment control with auto-tuning, temperature calibration and 9-zone PID for precise, repeatable testing.
body: Reliable control with temperature/humidity auto-tuning and temperature calibration.
PID control subdivided into 9 zones for improved stability.
Control and data handling for up to 32 devices via RS-485.
Graph display for convenient status monitoring.
Optional integration with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper for GMP audits.

cards.title: Example: 40°C / 75 %RH, 72 h hold (TH3-E-200)
cards.description: Heat-up to 40°C in roughly 36 minutes, cool-down back to ambient in roughly 40 minutes, 20 L tank sufficient with recirculation for the full run, holding ± 0.5°C / ± 1 %RH at steady state. Exact ramp and hold figures for your own setpoint and duration are confirmed by Inkarp's application team.

sections.disclaimer: Up to 100 segments can be set per pattern; the overall maximum is 2000 segments (not 100 × 100). The worked example above reproduces JeioTech's stated reference figures and is not a live calculator, since ramp curves are non-linear near setpoint — share your own setpoint and hold duration with Inkarp for a case-specific figure. Use the Load & Water Planning calculator above for shelf-load fit and water-refill estimates instead.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-PE?
faqs.answer: The TH3-PE operates from 0 to 100°C without humidity control.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 30 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-PE is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is TH3-PE different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: The tabletop series is selected by temperature range: TH3-KE covers -40 to 100°C, TH3-ME covers -20 to 100°C, and TH3-PE covers 0 to 100°C.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: It includes independent electronic and mechanical over-temperature protection, a surface temperature below 60°C, water-level alarms with automatic shut-off, a door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the stated reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can connect to a PC using standard RS-232 or optional RS-485, with mobile monitoring available through LC GreenBox and LC Connected.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: It can be integrated with optional LC DataKeeper software for FDA 21 CFR Part 11-compliant GMP audit records.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options.

longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech TH3-PE delivers precise benchtop temperature and humidity testing across 0 to 100°C and 30 to 95 %RH, with 25 L, 65 L and 100 L chamber options.
heroParagraphs: Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, external humidification and a double-sealed door, the TH3-PE maintains repeatable conditions in a compact footprint.
Its efficient water recirculation, dual over-temperature protection and optional connected monitoring support both routine tests and longer stability studies.

sections.title: TH3-PE at a Glance
sections.description: A compact tabletop environmental chamber for stability, material and routine environmental work.
body: The TH3-PE is engineered for laboratories that need reliable temperature and humidity control without dedicating floor space to a full-size chamber.
A 5.6-inch touch display shows set values, actual values, operating status and graphs. External humidification keeps the chamber cleaner and easier to maintain.
As an authorised JeioTech distributor and service provider in India, Inkarp supports consultation, configuration, installation, training and after-sales service.
